business_type: secular grower (enterprise workflow SaaS repositioning for agentic AI)
moat_source: workflow-of-record switching costs across IT/HR/CSM; evidence: raised guidance through a macro shock - but agentic AI puts the seat-based model itself in question, capping the rating

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% closed by year 3. All scenario FCF is SBC-adjusted (~40% haircut off reported FCF, reflecting ServiceNow's historically heavy issuance) - the audit fix applied.

sensitivity_key_driver: whether agentic AI expands or cannibalizes seat-based ACV
primary_model_risk: Agentic transition: the same technology behind the Control Tower bull case (agents doing work) undermines per-seat pricing (fewer human seats). The base case assumes ACV grows through the transition; the bear case assumes seats shrink faster than platform/agent pricing replaces them. Q2 (July 22) is the first evidence either way.
expectations_gap_key_variable: the agentic verdict: after the crash-and-rebound, the price (~13% above our expected IV) fairly reflects a coin-flip-weighted transition; the disagreement with the market is small
top_5_bull_arguments: Guidance RAISED through a geopolitical revenue shock - demand durability demonstrated
Now Assist $1M+ ACV customers +130% y/y: AI is currently expanding, not shrinking, contract value
Jensen Huang's 'OS for enterprise AI agents' endorsement positions NOW at the governance layer every agent deployment needs
~7x forward subscription revenue is the cheapest in the company's modern history
Bull case ($154) is 43% above the price if Control Tower becomes the standard
top_5_bear_arguments: Agents reduce human seats - the pricing model's foundation - and no one knows the net effect yet
SBC-adjusted, the cash economics are ~40% worse than headline FCF
A 14% single-day crash on one soft quarter shows zero multiple cushion
Expected IV ($94.80) sits ~12% below even the post-crash price
Conflicting weekly tape data (+15.5% vs +6.2%) reflects a market that cannot decide what this company is worth
thesis_breakers: Now Assist ACV cohort growth decelerating below 50% y/y
Net-new ACV declining while agent products ramp (cannibalization confirmed)
position_size_recommendation: 0-1%; watch July 22 - a strong agentic-ACV print near expected IV (~$95) would make this actionable
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced ratios. Subscription guidance and cohort metrics are reported; total-revenue/FCF path constructed from guidance plus historical FCF margin, with a 40% SBC haircut (SBC magnitude itself estimated from historical norms, not this year's filing) - confidence_level medium.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. Verified datapoints: -14% on Q1 print (CNBC), -9.24% June, Guggenheim upgrade to Buy with $125 target July 1 (TIKR), trailing P/E 65.87 (pass1). No verified multiple range beyond this.
